decisions.reason: The same-message kitchen MODIFY already captures the counter-side opening and refrigerator placement; the partition change requires no additional kitchen update or removal.
The corridor concern is already represented by its same-message INTRODUCE, and removing the purple-marked walls does not necessarily alter the corridor requirement further.
The source decision concerns marked walls, the counter side, the corridor, and refrigerators; it does not change Unit 3 bathroom geometry or fixtures.
